cohort: 400 women with term uncomplicated singleton pregnancy with occipitoanterior position during active labor
finding: Women with OSA <126° experienced a significantly longer duration of labor and higher rates of cesarean section, maternal complications, and fetal complications.
mod_finding: Women with OSA <126° had a higher incidence of CS compared to those with OSA ≥126° (46.3% vs. 5.7%).
